item: the app's own server start runs on the stdlib asyncio loop, never uvloop
summary: uvicorn's loop=auto picked uvloop, whose resolves and connects bypass the airplane socket guard; _serve now pins loop=asyncio and lifespan logs an error if a server started another way runs on uvloop. A bare python -m uvicorn start without --loop asyncio still runs on uvloop and is only warned. Release line: when started with its own launcher, the app's server now always runs on Python's own event loop, so airplane mode's network guard also covers connections made from that loop.
